style: A realistic, unstaged smartphone photo, natural light, slightly cluttered, wide view taken from about three metres away, nothing in the frame is centred or highlighted.

photos.tick: Someone sitting on a porch step after a hike, the photo shows their legs in shorts and hiking boots with socks, a backpack and a water bottle beside them. On the lower leg, small, a single black-legged deer tick attached to the skin.
photos.extinguisher: A long office corridor with doors, a water cooler, a notice board and a fire extinguisher hanging on the wall halfway down. The extinguisher's small round pressure gauge has its needle in the red zone, empty.
photos.medicine_cabinet: A bathroom with an open mirrored medicine cabinet on the wall above the sink, three crowded shelves of pill bottles and boxes, a towel, a toothbrush cup. Every bottle and box has a plain printed label with its name in large capitals: VITAMIN D3, MELATONIN, CALCIUM, LORATADINE ALLERGY RELIEF, ANTACID, FISH OIL, ZINC, MAGNESIUM, PROBIOTIC, and one white bottle reading IBUPROFEN 200 MG PAIN RELIEVER. No other pain reliever. Several bottles look alike: white and amber, similar sizes.
